pearls.purpose: Sandstorm-native chat grain. TypeScript Express + Apollo GraphQL + better-sqlite3 server with session-scoped end-to-end field encryption performed in the browser. The server stays blind on E2E1: envelopes (single AES-256-GCM DEK per browser session); mixed-mode is supported, so plaintext chat coexists with encrypted fields when the operator opts in. Per-grain identity, role-aware permissions for admin / collaborator / auditor / client / assistant / public viewer.

encryption.scheme: AES-256-GCM, single browser-session DEK; server stores E2E1: envelopes verbatim

adminOnly.name: Manage grain membership
adminOnly.purpose: Owner-only: invite / remove members, set role assignments.

anyMember.name: Send / receive chat messages
anyMember.purpose: Standard chat — per-message E2E encryption is opt-in client-side.

anyMember.name: Publish own public key
anyMember.purpose: Register a per-user public key in the grain directory for future per-recipient envelope wrapping.

blockchains.purpose: Release attestation only — no per-grain on-chain state.

capnp.name: grain.MainView
capnp.purpose: Standard Sandstorm grain interface — UiView for users opening the app, Restore for resuming a saved capability, Drop for releasing one.

http.name: POST /api/graphql
http.purpose: GraphQL endpoint for chat operations (insertMessage, listMessages, upsertUserPublicKey, getUserPublicKey).
